<section class="nu-hero"><div class="nu-hero-content"><p class="nu-kicker">Beach House</p><h1>Healthy eats, crafty drinks, and watersports on the beach.</h1><p>Enjoy the comforts of home in paradise in our laid-back but contemporary lodging at Numero Uno Beach House. Featuring fresh eats, cold drinks, watersports and rentals.</p><div class="nu-btns"><a class="nu-btn" href="/hotel/">Stay with us</a><a class="nu-btn alt" href="/dining/">Dine with us</a></div></div></section>
<section class="nu-section"><div class="nu-two"><div><p class="nu-eyebrow">Stay with us</p><h2>Enjoy the comforts of home in paradise</h2><p>Enjoy the comforts of home in paradise in our laid-back but contemporary lodging at Numero Uno Beach House. Featuring fresh eats, cold drinks, watersports and rentals.</p><a class="nu-btn" href="https://hotel2625.openhotel.com/results.cfm" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Book Beach House</a></div><img decoding="async" src="/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/beach-house-angled.jpg" alt="Numero Uno Beach House"></div></section>
<section class="nu-section"><div class="nu-two flip"><img decoding="async" src="/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/img-beachhouse-food@2x.webp" alt="Beach House food and drink"><div><p class="nu-eyebrow">Food &#038; Drink</p><h2>Freshly prepared favorites with a local twist</h2><p>Enjoy breakfast or lunch in our newly renovated bar and kitchen. Try freshly prepared favorites while taking in the sites and relaxing sounds of Ocean Park Beach.</p><a class="nu-btn" href="/dining/">Dine with us</a></div></div></section>
<section class="nu-section"><div class="nu-grid"><article class="nu-card"><img decoding="async" src="/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/img-beachhouse-watersports@2x.webp" alt="Watersports"><div><h3>Watersports</h3><p>Rent, learn, ride and chase the wind from Ocean Park.</p></div></article><article class="nu-card"><img decoding="async" src="/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Slam_69_0014.png" alt="Kiteboarding"><div><h3>Kiteboarding</h3><p>Catch the trade winds with Puerto Rico’s kite culture.</p></div></article><article class="nu-card"><img decoding="async" src="/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/KiteSurfer.jpg" alt="Surfing"><div><h3>Surf &#038; Wake</h3><p>From tow-in sessions to mellow water adventures.</p></div></article></div></section>
<section class="nu-section"><div class="nu-two"><div><p class="nu-eyebrow">Rest &#038; Relax</p><h2>Comforts of home in paradise</h2><p>Enjoy the subtle sights and sounds of the ocean out your window and take in unforgettable sunsets. Oversized windows frame the stunning Ocean Park Beach while you relax in our clean and spacious Deluxe Ocean View Room. Come see why Numero Uno Beach House is Puerto Rico’s destination for a truly unforgettable experience in paradise.</p><a class="nu-btn" href="/hotel/">See rooms</a></div><img decoding="async" src="/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/img-beachhouse-sleep@2x.webp" alt="Beach House room"></div></section>
